title: Leave it to the caller to choose the calculation rules
goal: Pass the function as a parameter and call it when processing the current record.
summary: The service desk can choose to double the points or reissue 3 points according to the configuration. The ready-made scoreFor demo selects a rule and passes it to applyScore.
tasks: completes applyScore(points, transform). Call transform with points as its argument.
When transform is not passed in, keep the double points callback in the starting file.
limits the result returned by the callback to no less than 0, and then returns the value.

example.code:
function apply(value, convert) { return convert(value); }
apply(3, (value) => value * 4); // 12
example.note: Pass the function name without parentheses. The receiving function calls it.

hint: Call transform(points), then use Math.max(0, result) to enforce the lower bound.
